query:
SELECT id                          AS "id!",
                   ''                          AS "token!",
                   COALESCE(userid, '')        AS "userid!",
                   COALESCE(description, '')   AS "description!",
                   COALESCE(isactive, false)   AS "isactive!",
                   expiresat                   AS "expiresat!",
                   NULL::bigint                AS "lastnotifiedat"
              FROM useraccesstokens
             WHERE expiresat > 0
               AND expiresat <= $1
               AND isactive = true
             ORDER BY expiresat ASC
             LIMIT $2
